participantFlowModule.preAssignmentDetails:
Overall 168 participants were screened at 23 centers in China. A total of 119 participants were treated with Dato-DXd.

  • For TNBC cohort, 106 participant was screened at 14 centers in China. 79 participants received Dato-DXd at the 14 centers.
  • For NSCLC cohort, 62 participant was screened at 12 centers in China. 40 participants received Dato-DXd at 11 centers.

Note: 3 centers screened both TNBC participants and NSCLC participants.
participantFlowModule.recruitmentDetails:
This Phase 1/2, open-label, multiple-cohort, single-arm study was conducted in participants with Advanced Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) and Triple-Negative Breast Cancer(TNBC) in China.

  • For TNBC cohort, first participant was screened on 11Jul2022, last participant was screened on 27Apr2023.
  • For NSCLC cohort, first participant was screened on 29Aug2022, last participant was screened on 21Mar2023.
